findings.title: SQL Injection in Authentication Endpoint
findings.description: SQL injection vulnerability confirmed via time-based and error-based payloads on username field.

metadata.fix_recommendation: Sanitize user inputs and employ prepared statements.

findings.title: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
findings.description: The Content-Security-Policy response header is missing, increasing vulnerability to XSS attacks.

metadata.fix_recommendation: Configure a robust Content-Security-Policy HTTP header.
